title: Rank-Free Inference on Joint Efficiency Gains in Staggered Triple Differences
banked_reason: D-0.5 final NO-PASS: the exact nonclosed-null distance equals distance to its closure, invalidating claimed exclusion and automatic rank-zero oracle recovery after the last authorized reset.
gap_reasons: The statistic inf_{η∈Nδ} distance equals distance to cl(Nδ), so it necessarily admits excluded rank-loss closure points; strict CAD inequalities cannot make this an exact nonclosed-null distance test.
Separation only from lower-rank null strata does not exclude nearby higher-rank strata whose closures contain a rank-loss point; rank-zero oracle recovery is not automatic.
Angle 0 exhausted on non-nested Bellégo comparator drift, and angle 2 did not meet the field novelty floor.
proof_attempt_summary: Three proposal angles were explored through ten angle-1 revisions; no D0 derivation or Lean formalization began. The final revision successfully replaced the synthetic carrier with an actual OVS finite-cell RIF collision and verified Δ(0)=0 with Δ(t)→8, but its exact-null test collapsed because distance to a nonclosed null equals distance to its closure and its rank-zero oracle claim was false. A future explicitly authorized retry would need closure-calibrated semialgebraic inference, all-competing-strata separation, and the recorded Chen–Fang/OVS citation corrections.
tldr: The kernel is rank-free inference for the discontinuous Moore--Penrose variance gain, implemented for an actual Ortiz--Villavicencio--Sant'Anna shared-cell DDD system. The observed four-period law has cohorts \(2,3,4,\infty\), two eligibility groups, saturated nuisances, and a ten-dimensional regular probability-and-conditional-mean chart. Direct derivation from OVS equations (4.16)--(4.17) yields the four RIF coordinates and the factor \(F(t)\); the actual separate comparator gives a gain equal to zero at \(t=0\) and tending to eight from every nonzero nearby \(t\). A terminating common-draw CAD envelope searches every exact-rank null stratum, controls CDFs, left CDFs, atoms, and quantiles uniformly, and delivers honest coverage and threshold-band power without selecting rank.
gap: The banked DDD receipt supplies only a pointwise descriptive gain under a positive-definite inverse identity. OVS supplies pairwise RIFs and within-target optimal weights, not inference on the cross-target joint-versus-separate gain. Directional-delta methods do not cover a discontinuous pseudoinverse map, and singularity-robust moment tests do not test its nonclosed exact null.
fill: The project derives the actual OVS collision from its published influence equations, proves primitive-chart regularity, characterizes the random projection limit, and constructs a globally terminating atom-aware Gaussian envelope with uniform size, coverage, and threshold-band power approximation.
